The target video uses restrained live-action romantic-drama cinematography with cool blue-hour ambience, warm practical station lights, subtle 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field, and natural facial micro-expressions.

[Shot 1] A long-lens wide shot establishes a nearly empty outdoor railway platform at dusk. <Subject 1>, wearing a charcoal wool coat over a dark knit shirt and carrying a small travel bag, stands near the open train doors on the right side of the composition. <Subject 2>, wearing a pale cream coat and a muted burgundy scarf, faces him several steps away on the left. Passengers move between them in soft focus while wind lifts <Subject 2>'s loose hair strands and moves the hem of <Subject 1>'s coat. Neither immediately approaches. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as the station clock continues counting down behind them.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a restrained medium two-shot from the side. The departing train remains behind <Subject 1>, while <Subject 2> stands close enough to touch him but keeps her hands around the end of her scarf. She looks at the open train door and then back into his eyes. <Subject 2> (S1), speaking in a soft young female voice with a slight tremble and a measured pace, says: <d>[English] I thought we'd have more time.</d> She attempts a smile, but it fades before fully forming.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1>. Warm train light crosses one side of his face while the rest remains in cool evening shadow. His eyes lower, his jaw tightens briefly, and he gives a quiet breath through his nose. <Subject 1> (S2), speaking in a low young male voice with restrained regret, replies: <d>[English] We did. We just spent it being afraid.</d> His gaze returns to her, carrying apology without asking for forgiveness.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.500, the camera cuts to an intimate close-up of <Subject 2>. Her blue-grey eyes become moist, but no tear falls. A passing traveler briefly obscures the frame; when the traveler clears, her expression has softened. <Subject 2> (S1) says with a steadier voice and the beginning of acceptance: <d>[English] Then let's not be afraid of goodbye.</d> She gives him a small, genuine smile.

[Shot 5] At 00:12.500, the camera cuts back to a long-lens medium-wide shot. <Subject 1> reaches forward, and their fingertips meet briefly rather than forming an embrace. The train departure signal sounds. <Subject 2> gently releases his hand first. <Subject 1> steps backward into the train while maintaining eye contact. The doors begin closing between them. End at exactly 00:15.000 with both characters giving the same restrained, accepting smile through the narrowing doorway. Natural anatomy, stable identities, accurate English lip synchronization, no exaggerated crying, no dramatic embrace, no subtitles, no visible generated text, 16:9.

overall_soundscape:
Cold platform wind, distant station announcements, rolling suitcases, footsteps, low passenger chatter, and the quiet mechanical hum of the waiting train continue beneath the dialogue. The departure signal sounds once near the end, followed by the soft pneumatic movement of the closing doors.

non_diegetic_music:

detailed_description:
Grounded photorealistic drama, clean low-noise cinematic image, restrained grain, smooth tonal gradients, natural skin and fabric texture, no excessive sharpening and no dirty filter. Early evening on a destroyed downtown street. Maintain the 180-degree axis: the hero begins screen left in the midground facing screen right; the mother and child enter and stay screen right in the foreground facing screen left, about 2 meters from him. The overturned smoking sedan remains far screen left; wet rubble and damaged millennium-era buildings fill the background. No readable on-screen text, subtitles, UI, logos, or watermarks appear.
[Shot 1] Low camera skims across wet glass, masonry, and shallow puddles. Black smoke rises from the overturned sedan at far screen left. The camera tilts up through drifting smoke toward the ruined street and cold gray-blue sky.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, a steady medium shot reveals <Subject 1> standing alone among rubble at screen left. His charcoal suit is torn at the left shoulder, soot covers his chest and knees, and mild blood marks his left brow and cheek. He breathes hard, chest rising in ragged rhythms; as movement enters frame at screen right, his breath catches for one beat. He blinks hard once, eyes already red-rimmed under their dust, his nostrils flare with a shallow breath, and the fingers of his uninjured hand slowly curl into a fist at his side. He turns his full attention toward the mother and child.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.300, hold a medium two-shot. <Subject 2> drops to her knees at screen right, cradling <Subject 3> horizontally across her forearms: the child's head rests in the crook of her elbow, her limp body lying flat across the mother's lap and arms, face upturned and visible, eyes closed. A small thin smear of blood runs from the child's hairline at her left temple, just beside the yellow hair clip. The mother's eyes find the blood, then snap up and lock on <Subject 1>, unblinking; her inner brows rise and pull together into a pleading knot, tears well up and spill through the dust on her cheeks. Her lips tremble apart, her chin tightens and dimples, her nostrils flare. Her breath comes in two or three short catching inhales before she can force words out. She leans forward from the knees toward him without closing the distance, one hand cradling the child's head while the other arm clamps the small body tighter, knuckles whitening. She looks directly at <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> (S1) says: <d>[EN]You said you'd save her... alive! Not like this!</d> Her mouth synchronizes exactly; the shout cracks and breaks at the end, raw rather than theatrical, then collapses into a sob. <Subject 1> remains silent, lips closed; his gaze drops to the child's face and does not move, his jaw sets, and he swallows once, the motion visible in his throat.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.300, close medium shot across the same axis. <Subject 1> slowly lifts his right hand toward <Subject 3>; the fingers tremble faintly, then stop 30 centimeters short of the child and hover. <Subject 2> hunches forward over the child lying across her arms, folding her shoulders over the small body as if to shield it; her shoulders lift in small rapid jerks with each broken breath, her fingers tightening in the child's cardigan, her face lowering until her brow nearly touches the child's hair as she sobs without words. The hero's hand lowers. Cut to a close-up of his dust-covered face: his eyes squeeze shut for one beat as if hit; when they open they are red-rimmed and glistening, lashes wet, and he blinks rapidly several times to force the tears back. His gaze sinks to the child and stays there, drifting out of focus for a beat as if he cannot make sense of what he sees, one brow drawing slightly higher than the other. His lower lip is caught between his teeth and released; the muscle along his jaw jumps; he swallows hard. His breath runs shallow and fast through flared nostrils, his chest lifting once in a tremor he cannot control. His lips part as if to speak, but no sound comes; after a moment the hovering hand slowly curls into a trembling fist and drops back to his side.
[Shot 5] At 00:14.200, one continuous slow crane pullback from behind and above <Subject 1>. Reveal <Subject 2> now sitting on the wet rubble at his right, her weight surrendered to the ground, shoulders slumped and caved inward; <Subject 3> still lies horizontally across her arms, the child's head resting in the crook of her elbow, eyes closed and face slack. The mother's tears keep sliding silently through the dust; her gaze is fixed on the child's face and no longer tracks anything else; one hand rises to stroke the child's hair once, slowly, then stops and rests there. The camera continues pulling back past the smoking sedan, wet street, wrecked buildings, drifting smoke, and tiny emergency flashes. The three figures become small within the ruins. Final visible state: hero stands left of center, head lowered, shoulders curled inward, red eyes still fixed on the mother and child; mother sits on the ground at his right, folded gently over the child in her arms; smoke drifts through the street; the pullback naturally fades to black at 18 seconds.

overall_soundscape: Wind moves through the ruined street. Fire crackles near the overturned sedan, distant emergency sirens pulse, and small pieces of debris settle. The hero's ragged breathing is close in the first half, catching and going shallow after the mother's shout; the mother's crying runs from a broken shout into segmented sobbing, then softens into silent tears as the camera pulls away.

integrated_multimodal_description: Grounded, warm, photorealistic coming-of-age drama in a fictional American public high-school library just after lunch. The scene takes place inside one long aisle between two parallel rows of tall dark-wood bookshelves: the shelf row the characters browse runs along one side of the aisle, densely packed with book spines whose titles are indistinct and non-readable; a second identical shelf row runs parallel along the opposite side; between the two rows is the clear open floor of the aisle, wide enough for two people. Warm golden afternoon sunlight streams through tall windows at the far end of the aisle, cutting between the shelf rows in visible beams with slow-drifting dust motes; a worn leather sofa, a bulletin board with indistinct club posters, and a long table sit in the wider library area beyond the rows. HARD SPATIAL RULE: both characters always stand and walk on the open aisle floor, their full bodies inside the gap between the two shelf rows with clear space around them; the bookshelves are solid physical furniture — characters never pass through a shelf, never emerge from inside or behind a shelf, and a character's body must never overlap shelf wood or books. A shy 16-year-old girl with a soft oval face, warm brown eyes, shoulder-length chestnut hair, and a few light freckles wears a pale knit cardigan, pleated skirt, and canvas shoes, carrying textbooks hugged loosely against her chest; she stands at the browse-side shelf near screen left, facing the spines. A slim, bookish 16-year-old boy with an oval face, hazel eyes, slightly messy dark curls, thin silver metal-frame glasses, a navy hoodie over a plaid shirt, worn jeans, and a book-filled messenger bag over one shoulder enters from the far end of the aisle at screen right — his full body clearly visible walking in the open gap BETWEEN the two shelf rows, shelf rows visible on both sides of him with floor space around his feet — then approaches along the aisle and stops at the same shelf section, facing the same spines. Maintain these facial features, hair, and wardrobe consistently in every shot. Maintain the 180-degree axis: girl stays screen left, boy screen right in every shot. Micro-expression direction is restrained and sequential: eyes react first, then breath and shoulders, then hands; never use exaggerated facial acting. Shyness is carried by small physical tells only: a faint natural pink rising on the ears, cheeks and neck, one extra blink, a swallowed breath, fingers tightening on an object. No readable on-screen text, subtitles, UI, logos, or watermarks appear.
[Shot 1] A warm medium-wide shot from three-quarter view down the aisle: the two shelf rows frame the left and right edges of the frame and recede toward the golden windows at the far end. The girl is already at the browse-side shelf near screen left, tracing spines. The boy walks in from the far end of the aisle at screen right, positioned unmistakably in the open floor gap between the two shelf rows — shelves on both sides of him, his feet on the aisle floor, clear space between his body and each shelf — and approaches along the aisle until he reaches the same shelf section. They both slow and stop, drawn to the same worn novel on the shelf at chest height between them.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, close on the book and their hands: the girl's hand enters frame from the left, the boy's hand enters frame from the right, both reaching across the open aisle space for the same worn novel on the shelf; fingertips lightly touch at the spine and both pull back at once. The girl's eyes flick from the contact sideways to the boy for less than a second, then drop; she blinks once, and a faint pink rises over her ears and cheeks. The boy takes one small caught breath, his shoulders draw in slightly, and he swallows once, the motion visible in his throat.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.600, alternating medium close-ups as they turn toward each other in the open aisle space, the opposite shelf row with softly blurred book spines behind them, never overlapping their bodies: the girl tucks hair behind her ear, presses her lips together to contain a smile, and lets one corner of her mouth lift before looking down; her fingers tighten on the edge of the textbook she holds. The boy adjusts his glasses, glances back at the shelf as if pretending to read another spine, then gives a quick glance back at her; the tips of his ears are pink, his hand grips the bag strap a beat too long, his smile begins unevenly at one corner while his eyes remain nervous, followed by one fast blink.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.600, the girl reaches her hand back toward the book, her hand entering from frame left. She takes a tiny inhale, raises her eyes to meet his for one clear beat, and says softly (S1): <d>[EN]You first.</d> Her lips synchronize exactly; the line is almost a whisper, breathy, with the tail of the word falling away. After speaking, she lowers her gaze briefly but keeps a small contained smile, the pink still on her cheeks. The boy stays silent with lips closed; he swallows again, and his eyes soften as he looks at her.
[Shot 5] At 00:11.200, a steady two-shot facing each other in the aisle, girl screen left and boy screen right, both standing on the open aisle floor with blurred shelves behind them and golden light at the far end: the boy exhales a small nervous laugh through his nose, lifts his eyes to her, and says (S2): <d>[EN]Maybe... we could share it?</d> The line ends in a tentative upward inflection, his voice low and slightly rough. The girl first watches his reaction, then lets her smile spread naturally into her eyes. They each rest one hand on the book — her hand on the left side, his on the right — and carefully pull it free from the shelf together as sunlight falls across their hands. Final visible state: girl at screen left and boy at screen right, standing close on the open floor in front of the shelf, half-turned to face each other, both holding the book between them, shoulders dropped and relaxed, the pink still faint on both their ears, sharing a quiet shy smile.

overall_soundscape: Soft library air-conditioning, distant page turns, and a faint chair scrape establish the quiet room; the boy's soft footsteps approach along the shelf aisle, echoing faintly between the shelf rows. The book slides softly from the shelf. After the dialogue, a small shared breath and the rustle of their sleeves remain audible.
